name: demoblaze-cypress-tests
description: Cypress + TypeScript end-to-end tests for the login and laptop purchase flow on demoblaze.com

scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean:reports && cypress run --expose grepTags=@smoke
scripts.test:api: npm run clean:reports && cypress run --expose grepTags=@api
scripts.test:chrome: npm run clean:reports && cypress run --browser chrome
scripts.test:docker: docker build -t demoblaze-tests . && docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -e TEST_ENV -v "$PWD/tests/reports:/e2e/tests/reports" demoblaze-tests
